CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "level" integer NOT NULL, "city_merge_status" integer NOT NULL, "entity_type" varchar(80) NULL, "raw_entity_type" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "parent_id" varchar(128) NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "area_km2" decimal NULL, "density" decimal NULL, "pop_latest" bigint NULL, "representatives" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("representatives" >= 0), "pop_latest_date" date NULL, "last_census_year" integer NULL, "url" varchar(500) NULL, "data_wd" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "annotations" text NOT NULL, "most_populate_city_id" varchar(128) NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_area_country_code" UNIQUE ("country_code", "code"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea_capitals" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "from_adminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "to_adminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_derivedcountry" ("slug" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "source_country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_derivedcountryconfig" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "country_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_derivedcountry" ("slug") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "slug" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "content" text NOT NULL, "source_country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "derived_country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "derconf_country_slug_uniq" UNIQUE ("country_id", "slug"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_derivedsubdivision" ("slug" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "internal_name" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "source_country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "entity_type" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "content" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_dynamictranslation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "subject_type" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "subject_key" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "field" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "source_text" text NOT NULL, "source_language" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "language" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "text" text NOT NULL, "source" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "prompt_version" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "input_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "needs_review" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "dyn_translation_subject_field_lang_uniq" UNIQUE ("subject_type", "subject_key", "country_code", "field", "language"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_entitytypeinference" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "raw_entity_type" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "level" integer NULL, "context_key" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "canonical_entity_type" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "source_language" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "confidence" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "reason" text NOT NULL, "source" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "model" varchar(120) NOT NULL, "prompt_version" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "input_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "needs_review" bool NOT NULL, "is_active" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "entity_type_inference_context_uniq" UNIQUE ("country_code", "level", "raw_entity_type", "context_key"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea" ("id" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "level" integer NOT NULL, "entity_type" varchar(80) NULL, "parent_id" varchar(128) NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "area_km2" decimal NULL, "density" decimal NULL, "pop_latest" bigint NULL, "population_index" decimal NOT NULL, "province_status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "depends_on_id" varchar(128) NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "representatives" integer unsigned NULL CHECK ("representatives" >= 0), "capital_names_by_language" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("capital_names_by_language") OR "capital_names_by_language" IS NULL)), "most_populate_city_id" varchar(128) NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, "municipal_level" integer NULL, CONSTRAINT "uniq_nuevo_area_country_code" UNIQUE ("country_code", "code"), CONSTRAINT "nuevo_area_municipal_level_valid" CHECK (("municipal_level" IS NULL OR ("municipal_level" >= 1 AND "municipal_level" <= 5))), CONSTRAINT "nuevo_area_population_index_nonnegative" CHECK ("population_index" >= '0'));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea_capitals" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "nuevoadminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "adminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea_municipios_originales" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "nuevoadminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_nuevoadminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "adminarea_id" varchar(128) NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_adminarea" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_scrapingconfig" ("slug" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "content" text NOT NULL, "content_hash" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "source_path" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "pages_count" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("pages_count" >= 0), "cities_count" integer unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("cities_count" >= 0), "has_representation" bool NOT NULL, "schema_version" smallint unsigned NOT NULL CHECK ("schema_version" >= 0), "scrape_types" varchar(128) NOT NULL, "pages_config" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("pages_config") OR "pages_config" IS NULL)), "is_valid" bool NOT NULL, "validation_error" text NOT NULL, "imported_at" datetime NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_subdivisiongroup" ("slug" varchar(128) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "content" text NOT NULL, "source_country_code" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_visual_asset" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "entity_key" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "entity_name" varchar(300) NOT NULL, "country_code" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "kind" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "wikidata_id" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "commons_filename" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "remote_url" text NOT NULL, "local_path" varchar(500) NOT NULL, "local_exists" bool NOT NULL, "source" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "status" varchar(40) NOT NULL, "error" text NOT NULL, "license_name" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "author" text NOT NULL, "attribution" text NOT NULL, "source_url" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "ciudades_visual_asset_entity_kind_uniq" UNIQUE ("entity_type", "entity_key", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_visual_asset_translation" ("id" integer NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "asset_id" bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES "ciudades_del_mundo_visual_asset" ("id") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, "language" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "title" varchar(300) NOT NULL, "description" text NOT NULL, "blazon" text NOT NULL, "source" varchar(80) NOT NULL, "needs_review" bool NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "ciudades_visual_asset_translation_uniq" UNIQUE ("asset_id", "language"));

CREATE TABLE "ciudades_del_mundo_webtask" ("id" varchar(32) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "key" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "label" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "args" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("args") OR "args" IS NULL)), "status" varchar(20) NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime NOT NULL, "started_at" datetime NULL, "finished_at" datetime NULL, "returncode" integer NULL, "cancel_requested" bool NOT NULL, "log_path" varchar(500) NULL, "output" text NOT NULL CHECK ((JSON_VALID("output") OR "output" IS NULL)), "updated_at" datetime NOT NULL);
